## Body

PASS-WITH-NOTES — static performance/284, exact16b75f3b8bc510e8a305ecd7ca49044b3be27b1c, base14226920. HEAD matched and complete six-file delta inspected. No builds/tests, benchmark, live measurement, extension reload or daemon change by performance. This cost verdict is not ship acceptance and does not settle the reviewer's reported ordering regression.

The packet/ledger's "no new launch, loop or timer" is only partly true: no new OS-launch site or recurring poller, but there IS a bounded activity retry loop and a new activityDelay -> node:timers/promises.sleep timer site.

| Changed work | Static rate/bound and scaling |
| --- | --- |
| Busy native Copilot body batches | Floor is job.last_wake_at: one new settled batch per job per I=--min-interval; owner total is sum over its jobs, not one aggregate seat cap. Production100ms tick adds a nominal10/job/s ceiling; I=0 is allowed. At default60s,80owners with one job each offer at most1.333batches/s. |
| Newly eligible quiet busy jobs | Once the floor expires, each job reaches event_stats on the existing100ms tick even with no pending event: up to10 checks/job/s, two explicit SQL/check (schema + COUNT/SUM/MAX). The aggregate visits that job's retained event history H, including settled rows: O(10*sum H). Eighty such jobs offer800checks/1600SQL/s. These are inferred offered-work bounds, not measurements. |
| Successful registration | Adds one primary /v1/activity post when a state is known and the route supported; zero with unknown state/unsupported route. Healthy rate is the successful-registration rate per native extension. |
| Failed publication episode | At most six primary attempts: original + five retries. Waits1,2,5,10,30s total48s scheduled sleep, not a wall-time bound. Existing400/422 context-report fallback can add one post/attempt: conservative12logicalRPCs/call; ordinarily seven maximum if one rejected grant is cleared and never refreshed. /v1/activity does not use DaemonClient's /v1/send restart-fetch loop. |
| Retry timers and lifetime | Up to five newly armed waits/call, at most one activity retry sleep active per bridge; inherited request-deadline timers also run for added RPCs. Newer state/registration or stop aborts a pending wait. No lifetime cap per observed state/outage: registration, another transition, OR a same-state event after exhaustion resets activityState and starts another episode. |

For N seats, sum their registration/publication rates. Let Q count actually queued publishActivity calls (including repeated same-state episodes): primary retry requests<=5Q, primary total<=6Q, conservative fallback-inclusive total<=12Q and new retry-wait arms<=5Q. Existing Promise serialization limits active activity publication, not queue depth; its retained backlog is not coalesced/bounded by one latest state, and retries prolong it.

Native scope is exactly harness Copilot AND native_extension_delivery. Non-native body sends keep accumulate-until-idle; events_fyi is unchanged. Open batches retain their batch/msg identity until settle; retry attempts can recur at the background tick before settlement and are not new batches. The bypass admits more existing batch-file/cold-routing/SQLite/delivery work; unchanged spawn inventory does not prove zero actual launches or model wakes. No new task/poller or launch code appears in the delta.

Cost wording owed in committed D-F230-1 and API docs: name the new bounded loop/timer, episode-versus-state cap, fallback posts and newly eligible per-tick reads. Coder/prime notified. No latency/CPU-saving claim; live proof remains separate. Glorious-smelt reported a RED ordering regression and owns repair/mutations; performance did not rerun it.
